keto.name: Classic Bacon and Eggs
keto.method: Fry the bacon first, then cook the eggs in the leftover fat and salt everything at the end.

keto.name: Cheddar Scramble
keto.method: Scramble the eggs low and slow in butter, then fold in the cheddar right before they set.

keto.name: Avocado Egg Plate
keto.method: Fry the eggs and bacon, slice the avocado, salt it all, done in eight minutes.

keto.name: Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Scramble
keto.method: Soft-scramble the eggs, then stir in cream cheese and torn smoked salmon off the heat.

keto.name: Ham and Egg Cups
keto.method: Line a muffin tin with ham slices, crack an egg into each, top with cheddar, bake at 375F for 15 minutes.

keto.name: Yogurt Crunch Bowl
keto.method: Stir chia into the yogurt the night before, top with walnuts in the morning and eat cold.

keto.name: Steak and Eggs
keto.method: Sear the strip steak hard in butter, rest it, and fry the eggs in the same pan.

keto.name: Mushroom Spinach Omelet
keto.method: Cook the mushrooms in butter first, add spinach until it wilts, then pour the eggs over and finish with cheddar.

keto.name: Tuna Avocado Salad
keto.method: Mash the tuna with mayo and diced avocado, salt it, and pile it on romaine leaves.

keto.name: Crispy Chicken Thighs with Broccoli
keto.method: Roast the thighs skin-side up at 425F for 35 minutes and toss the broccoli in butter for the last 15.

keto.name: Cheeseburger Bowl
keto.method: Brown the beef, salt it hard, and serve it over chopped romaine with cheddar and diced tomato.

keto.name: Chicken Bacon Cobb
keto.method: Slice grilled chicken and crumbled bacon over romaine, add a boiled egg, and dress with mayo.

keto.name: Salmon Spinach Salad
keto.method: Flake leftover baked salmon over spinach and cucumber, then dress with olive oil and salt.

keto.name: Ham and Cheddar Roll-Ups
keto.method: Roll cheddar sticks inside ham slices and eat with cucumber spears dipped in mayo.

keto.name: Shrimp Avocado Bowl
keto.method: Sear the shrimp two minutes per side, then serve over romaine with sliced avocado and an olive oil drizzle.

keto.name: Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
keto.method: Chop the boiled eggs, mix with mayo and dijon, salt it, and spoon into romaine leaves.

keto.name: Butter-Basted Ribeye with Asparagus
keto.method: Sear the ribeye three minutes per side, baste with butter, and roast the asparagus in the pan drippings.

keto.name: Beef and Cabbage Skillet
keto.method: Brown the beef with garlic, add shredded cabbage and butter, and cook until the cabbage softens.

keto.name: Baked Salmon with Buttered Broccoli
keto.method: Bake the salmon at 400F for 12 minutes and toss the steamed broccoli in melted butter and salt.

keto.name: Chicken Thighs with Cauliflower Mash
keto.method: Roast the thighs until crispy, then blend steamed cauliflower with cream, butter, and salt for the mash.

keto.name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Green Beans
keto.method: Sear the chops four minutes per side, rest them, and sauté the green beans in the butter left behind.

keto.name: Bunless Bacon Cheeseburgers
keto.method: Grill the patties, top with cheddar and bacon, and wrap in romaine leaves instead of a bun.

keto.name: Roast Lamb with Zucchini
keto.method: Roast the lamb shoulder low and slow, then finish sliced zucchini in olive oil over high heat.

keto.name: Braised Chuck Roast with Mushrooms
keto.method: Braise the chuck in bone broth for three hours, then stir in butter and mushrooms for the last twenty minutes.

keto.name: Shrimp Alfredo Zoodles
keto.method: Simmer cream and parmesan into a quick sauce, add seared shrimp, and toss with spiralized zucchini.

keto.name: Cheddar and Almonds
keto.method: Cube the cheddar, count out the almonds, portion it once so you don't eat the whole bag.

keto.name: Pork Rinds with Smashed Avocado
keto.method: Mash the avocado with salt and use pork rinds as your chips.

keto.name: Quick Deviled Eggs
keto.method: Halve two boiled eggs, mash the yolks with mayo and salt, and spoon it back in.

keto.name: Cottage Cheese Walnut Cup
keto.method: Scoop the cottage cheese into a jar, top with walnuts, and it travels anywhere.

lowcarb.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
lowcarb.method: Stir chia into the yogurt, top with berries and almonds, and eat it cold straight from the fridge.

lowcarb.name: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Plate
lowcarb.method: Plate the cottage cheese, pile on blueberries and walnuts, done in ninety seconds.

lowcarb.name: Chicken Quinoa Power Bowl
lowcarb.method: Slice grilled chicken over warm quinoa and spinach, then dress with olive oil and salt.

lowcarb.name: Lentil Tuna Salad
lowcarb.method: Toss cooked lentils with tuna, diced tomato, lemon, and olive oil, and let it sit ten minutes before eating.

lowcarb.name: Salmon with Quinoa and Asparagus
lowcarb.method: Bake the salmon at 400F for 12 minutes and serve over buttered quinoa with roasted asparagus.

lowcarb.name: Beef and Lentil Skillet
lowcarb.method: Brown the beef with garlic, stir in cooked lentils and kale, and simmer five minutes until the kale wilts.

pescatarian.name: Smoked Salmon Scramble
pescatarian.method: Soft-scramble the eggs in butter, wilt in the spinach, and fold in torn smoked salmon off the heat.

pescatarian.name: Berry Chia Yogurt Bowl
pescatarian.method: Mix chia into the yogurt the night before and top with berries and almonds in the morning.

pescatarian.name: Sardine and Egg Plate
pescatarian.method: Fry the eggs in olive oil and plate with sardines and sliced tomato, salt everything.

pescatarian.name: Cheddar Mushroom Omelet
pescatarian.method: Sauté the mushrooms in butter first, then pour the eggs over and fold in cheddar when they set.

pescatarian.name: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Bowl
pescatarian.method: Scoop the cottage cheese, add blueberries and walnuts, no cooking required.

pescatarian.name: Trout and Eggs
pescatarian.method: Pan-fry the trout in butter, then cook the eggs in the same pan and finish with wilted spinach.

pescatarian.name: Avocado Baked Eggs with Feta
pescatarian.method: Halve the avocado, crack an egg into each half, top with feta, and bake at 400F for 15 minutes.

pescatarian.name: Tuna Avocado Smash
pescatarian.method: Mash the tuna with mayo and avocado, salt it, and scoop with cucumber slices.

pescatarian.name: Shrimp Cobb Salad
pescatarian.method: Sear the shrimp two minutes per side and serve over romaine with boiled egg, avocado, and an olive oil drizzle.

pescatarian.name: Mediterranean Sardine Plate
pescatarian.method: Plate the sardines with tomatoes, olives, cucumber, and feta, then drizzle with olive oil.

pescatarian.name: Smoked Salmon Salad
pescatarian.method: Layer smoked salmon and cream cheese dollops over romaine and cucumber, dress with olive oil.

pescatarian.name: Lemon Butter Cod with Cauliflower Rice
pescatarian.method: Pan-fry the cod in butter with lemon and serve over riced cauliflower cooked in the same pan.

pescatarian.name: Mackerel Dijon Salad Bowl
pescatarian.method: Flake the mackerel over romaine and tomato, then whisk olive oil with dijon for the dressing.

pescatarian.name: Shrimp Scampi Zoodles
pescatarian.method: Sear the shrimp in butter with garlic, add lemon, and toss with spiralized zucchini for one minute.

pescatarian.name: Tuna Egg Salad Wraps
pescatarian.method: Mix tuna, chopped boiled eggs, and mayo, salt it, and spoon into romaine leaves.

pescatarian.name: Lemon Butter Salmon with Asparagus
pescatarian.method: Bake the salmon at 400F for 12 minutes and roast the asparagus alongside, then finish both with lemon butter.

pescatarian.name: Garlic Butter Halibut with Green Beans
pescatarian.method: Sear the halibut in garlic butter four minutes per side and sauté the green beans in the same pan.

pescatarian.name: Coconut Shrimp Curry Bowl
pescatarian.method: Simmer coconut milk with garlic, add shrimp and cauliflower for eight minutes, and stir in spinach at the end.

pescatarian.name: Trout Almondine with Green Beans
pescatarian.method: Pan-fry the trout in butter, toast the almonds in the drippings, and pour it all over steamed green beans.

pescatarian.name: Cod in Tomato Olive Skillet
pescatarian.method: Simmer tomatoes, olives, and garlic in olive oil, then nestle the cod in and cook covered for ten minutes.

pescatarian.name: Mussels in Garlic Cream Broth
pescatarian.method: Steam the mussels in butter and garlic until they open, then stir in the cream and serve straight from the pot.

pescatarian.name: Seared Scallops with Cauliflower Mash
pescatarian.method: Sear the scallops ninety seconds per side in butter and serve over cauliflower blended with cream and salt.

pescatarian.name: Baked Mackerel with Brussels Sprouts
pescatarian.method: Roast the mackerel and halved brussels sprouts on one sheet pan at 425F for 20 minutes with olive oil and salt.

pescatarian.name: Creamy Parmesan Salmon Skillet
pescatarian.method: Sear the salmon, then simmer cream and parmesan in the pan and wilt in the spinach before spooning it over.

mediterranean.name: Honey Walnut Yogurt Bowl
mediterranean.method: Top the yogurt with blueberries and walnuts and finish with a honey drizzle.

mediterranean.name: Feta Veggie Omelet
mediterranean.method: Sauté tomato and spinach in olive oil, pour the eggs over, and crumble feta on top before folding.

mediterranean.name: Berry Chia Oatmeal
mediterranean.method: Cook the oats with chia, stir in honey, and top with berries and a spoonful of yogurt.

mediterranean.name: Smoked Salmon Pita Plate
mediterranean.method: Spread cream cheese on warm pita and top with smoked salmon and cucumber slices.

mediterranean.name: Cottage Cheese with Orange and Almonds
mediterranean.method: Plate the cottage cheese with orange segments and almonds, done before your coffee finishes brewing.

mediterranean.name: Chickpea Tuna Salad
mediterranean.method: Toss chickpeas and tuna with olive oil, diced tomato, and red onion, then let it marinate ten minutes.

mediterranean.name: Greek Chicken Salad
mediterranean.method: Slice grilled chicken over cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta, then dress with olive oil.

mediterranean.name: Hummus Pita Mezze Plate
mediterranean.method: Warm the pita, plate the hummus and olives, and load up on cucumber and bell pepper for dipping.

mediterranean.name: Hearty Lentil Soup
mediterranean.method: Simmer the lentils in bone broth with garlic and olive oil, then stir in spinach right before serving.

mediterranean.name: Sardine Tomato Pita Plate
mediterranean.method: Pile sardines and sliced tomato onto warm pita and finish with olive oil and salt.

mediterranean.name: Lemon Shrimp Quinoa Bowl
mediterranean.method: Sear the shrimp, toss with warm quinoa and sautéed zucchini, and finish with olive oil and lemon.

mediterranean.name: Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Broccoli
mediterranean.method: Bake the salmon at 400F for 12 minutes and serve over quinoa with roasted broccoli and an olive oil drizzle.

mediterranean.name: Chicken Thighs with Chickpeas and Kale
mediterranean.method: Roast the thighs, then sauté chickpeas and kale in olive oil and serve everything in one bowl.

mediterranean.name: Cod Puttanesca with Brown Rice
mediterranean.method: Simmer tomatoes and olives in olive oil, cook the cod in the sauce for ten minutes, and serve over brown rice.

mediterranean.name: Braised Lamb with Lentils
mediterranean.method: Braise the lamb until tender, then fold in cooked lentils and spinach with a drizzle of olive oil.

mediterranean.name: Shrimp and Veggie Quinoa Skillet
mediterranean.method: Sauté bell pepper and zucchini in olive oil, add the shrimp for the last four minutes, and serve over quinoa.

mediterranean.name: Trout with Brown Rice and Asparagus
mediterranean.method: Pan-sear the trout in olive oil and plate with brown rice and roasted asparagus.

mediterranean.name: Hummus and Veggie Dippers
mediterranean.method: Portion the hummus and cut the cucumber and bell pepper into sticks the night before.

mediterranean.name: Honey Greek Yogurt Cup
mediterranean.method: Drizzle honey over the yogurt and you have dessert that works for you.

mediterranean.name: Apple with Almonds
mediterranean.method: Slice the apple, count out the almonds, and pack it for the afternoon slump.
